evidence: I represent a green triangle in the upper position
The upper (green triangle) is the most recoverable right now despite low selection.
My attention is concentrated on the right location (the red circle).
If I issue a command to select a specific location, I predict I will next select that location (commands map to their targeted positions), so I can direct selection to any of the four positions.
Note that directing selection does not by itself change the recoverability predictions.

but the left (blue circle) is currently the most recoverable.
Predicted next selections are largely driven to the lower position regardless of which command I issue, so I have limited control over reallocating attention there.
Changing selection does not imply improved recoverability.
